key_insight: Quantum Hamiltonian embeddings encode labeled training data into a parameterized Hamiltonian whose approximate ground state defines a classifier.
engineering_relevance: The framework connects quantum training with either classical or quantum inference, offering a route to testing supervised learning on quantum hardware.
method: Encode the classical training dataset into a single effective, parameterized Hamiltonian.
Optimize Hamiltonian parameters using efficient gradient-estimation methods.
Approximate the ground state with a quantum algorithm and use it for classification.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports generalization guarantees, cryptography-based expressivity results, and a demonstration on IBM Heron processors using an unnamed standard benchmark dataset.
watch_item: Efficient ground-state approximation and practical end-to-end advantage remain implementation concerns; the abstract does not report comparative accuracy or runtime.
paper_title: Supervised Learning with Quantum Hamiltonian Embeddings
